query:
SELECT 
  m.attendeeId,
  m.timeSlot,
  COUNT(*) as meetingCount,
  GROUP_CONCAT(s.companyName ORDER BY m.id SEPARATOR ' | ') as sponsors,
  GROUP_CONCAT(m.id ORDER BY m.id SEPARATOR ' | ') as meetingIds
FROM meetings m
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
GROUP BY m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot;
